availability.note: Four AWD grades on sale nationwide since March 2026 (GSR dropped); confirmed by Chasing Cars and EV Central launch reports and CarsGuide's June 2026 Exceed Tourer review. mitsubishi-motors.com.au returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the configurator itself could not be opened.

listPrice.note: CarExpert price table, 'before on-road costs' in words; same four figures in Chasing Cars, EV Central, zecar and the CarsGuide MSRP price page; Exceed Tourer re-confirmed 'before on-road costs' in CarsGuide's 22 Jun 2026 review. No later price change found by search on the research date.

rangeKm.note: Mitsubishi's claimed WLTP electric range (EV Central, Chasing Cars, CarsGuide). ES is the only grade on 18-inch wheels (zecar, CarExpert review); European WLTP on 235/60R18 is 85 km (ADAC). Australian ADR figure 103 km is NEDC, rejected by the direction test. CarExpert's news item quoting 84 km WLTP is the pre-update NEDC figure mislabelled.

batteryKwh.note: Usable capacity not published anywhere found. 22.7 kWh is gross (ADAC 'Batteriekapazität (Brutto)'; auto motor und sport 'Brutto'). Estimate kept at ~83% of gross: ADAC WLTP grid energy per charge is 20-21 kWh (23.4 kWh/100km x 85 km; 25.5 x 83), and AMS measured 22.3 kWh wall energy for a full charge, both including AC charging losses of ~8-12%. A dealer portal (vision-mobility.de, failed to load) lists 19.0 kWh usable.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 18.9 / 86 x 100. ADAC WLTP kWh figures are weighted/grid quantities and not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: WLTP electric 86 km + 53 L tank / 7.1 L/100km x 100 (746 km). Tank 53 L from CarExpert's 2026 review (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2026-mitsubishi-outlander-phev-review) and ADAC; CarsGuide's launch news says 56 L (the pre-update tank).

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: European WLTP 'Batterie leer' (charge-sustaining) figure, same on 18- and 20-inch versions (ADAC). The previously held 6.7 L/100km was Mitsubishi Australia's figure for the pre-update 20 kWh car (CarExpert, Dec 2022). CarsGuide saw ~10 L/100km while the engine charged the pack; CarExpert's mixed-use test returned 5.2 L/100km.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined CO2 120 g/km or less; Outlander PHEV label is 27 g/km (CarExpert review).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: CarExpert 2026 Exceed PHEV review, seats up; same five-seat body on ES/Exceed/Exceed Tourer.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert 2026 Exceed PHEV review, rear seats folded to the roof.

seats.note: CarExpert price table seat counts (Aspire 7 seat / '5+2').

towKg.note: Braked towing 1600 kg (CarExpert review); European figure also 1600 kg (ADAC). Not from the Mitsubishi AU spec sheet (site blocked).

warrantyYears.note: Unconditional 5 years/100,000 km; 10 years conditional on dealer servicing (CarExpert, CarsGuide).

insuranceAnnual.note: Held 2026-07-28 judgement, re-anchored: mazda-cx-60-phev-pure $1750 at $63,790, kia-sorento-phev-s-awd $1800 at $70,880, byd-sealion-6-premium-awd $1700 at $52,990; stepped by grade price.

depreciationCurve.note: Held 2026-07-28 curve, slightly below the mainstream default for an ageing PHEV facing cheaper Chinese plug-in rivals with more EV range (reviewers call it overpriced); sits between kia-sorento-phev (mainstream-like 0.76/0.45) and mazda-cx-60-phev (0.73/0.41).
